PAIR.value: Synthetic 2025 ledger; seed 20251004; each payee/category Frequency creates that many transactions at Average. Account assignments weighted by Frequency within matching Credit or Checking types. USD assumed; zero opening balances. Savings categories mapped to income (rebates); None/Split to expense, since no split details exist. Source Min/Max, tax statuses, dividend rates and historical stock splits are metadata only. No holdings, quotes or investment trades invented.
